enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Intelligence +8: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Wisdom +8: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Charisma +8: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

enchantments.tooltip: Wizardry +154: +154 Enhancement bonus to spell points.
Parrying +3: +3 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +3 Insight bonus to Saves.
Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
